name: DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Area
description: Renders an area chart as an SVG data URI showing measure values across an axis with filled area

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Optional series color. Defaults to Power BI theme color

parameters.name: showAxis
parameters.description: Optional axis toggle. Defaults to FALSE

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Area' =
		(
			axisRef: ANYREF EXPR,
			measureRef: NUMERIC EXPR,
			color: STRING = BLANK(),
			showAxis: BOOLEAN = FALSE(),
			width: INT64 = 120,
			height: INT64 = 48
		) =>

			VAR _Marks =
				DaxLib.SVG.Compound.Area(
					0,          // x
                    0,          // y
                    width,      // width
                    height,     // height
					axisRef,    // axisRef
                    measureRef, // measureRef
                    color,      // fillColor
                    color,      // strokeColor
					,           // fillOpacity
                    ,           // minMarkColor
                    ,           // maxMarkColor
                    showAxis    // showAxis
				)

			RETURN
				IF( NOT ISBLANK( _Marks ), DaxLib.SVG.SVG( "100%", "100%", _Marks, "0 0 " & width & " " & height ) )
